name: affect-tracker-playground
description: Frozen feature-rich Affect Tracker playground and reproducibility checkpoint.

paragraphs: Preserved feature-rich playground. The annotated checkpoint-2026-09-03-feature-rich tag remains the reproducibility baseline. main additionally carries the repository relocation and the deliberately restored, locally packaged Photoatlas portrait catalog. Active minimal research-tool development continues in affect-tracker-research. No research-readiness, physical-device, or cross-platform qualification claim is attached to the playground.
The repository currently contains four Affect Tracker delivery surfaces inspired by AffectTracker:

All surfaces use the same valence/arousal mappings. Web and desktop share the JavaScript Flubber and face-engine adapters directly; native Quest uses an allocation-bounded Flubber port checked against JavaScript golden vectors.
features: A static, self-contained GitHub Pages 2D application for browser studies, including six selectable locally packaged Face + Flubber main-stage presentations with a canonical SVG fallback, with no CDN or project backend.

An offline Tauri v2/Rust desktop companion with the same selectable local face/Flubber preview and fallback, click-to-capture global key/mouse/wheel bindings, a click-through always-on-top overlay, and always-on local…
An experimental hosted WebXR participant runner for Meta Quest Browser.

A specialized native Meta Quest Spatial SDK player under vr/ that loads a local video/session manifest, renders a transparent movable Flubber, accepts Touch-controller input, and publishes same-LAN LSL.
